China on Sunday handed over 17 Filipino sailors it rescued from a shipwreck near Huangyan Dao to the Philippines. 
On Friday, a Singapore-registered cargo ship en route from the Philippines to China capsized in the waters near Huangyan Dao. The Chinese People's Liberation Army Southern Theater Command sent military aircraft to conduct search operations over the waters where the accident occurred. Two nearby China Coast Guard vessels also joined the rescue mission, along with teams from the Nanhai Rescue Bureau of the Ministry of Transport.
